3. To advise the President on the necessity of legisle-
tion for the raising and allocation of funds to promote
private housing through aided self-help in the small com-
munities as well as to make passible low-rental public
housing for low-income groups in principal cities and
for research into the most effective use of local raw mate-
rials for housing and other constructions;
4. To assist the President in evaluating existing housing
projects or programs and in determining how such proj-
ects or programs may be accelerated or improved; and
5. To make recommendations on such other matters as
the President may, from time to time, submit for study
and consideration.
The National Housing Cauncil is hereby authorized to
call upon any department, bureau, office, agency, or instru-
mentality of the Government for such assistance or in-
formation as may be needed to carry out its duties and
Done in the City of Manila, this 28th day of December,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-five,
